exposure: mommy makeover procedure (combined abdominoplasty and breast surgery)
cohort: The study included 726 patients who previously underwent abdominoplasty by the senior author, with 15% of them having undergone 'Mommy-makeovers'.
finding: Mommy makeovers do not display a safety concern when compared to isolated abdominoplasties, with no significant difference found in adverse events after accounting for confounders.
